_doc: ASHRAE 140 Case 810 annual cooling reference for the surrogate-layer MAE gate (issue #3584). The surrogate's annual cooling kWh (solved by `SurrogateThermalModel::solve_timesteps`) is compared against the EnergyPlus published midpoint. The deviation is reported as a percentage of the band midpoint. The STRICT gate fires when an ONNX model is loaded and the deviation exceeds the 5% tolerance; the FALLBACK gate (no model loaded) reports the deviation informatively and exits 0 unless the deviation regresses beyond the recorded baseline beyond regression_tolerance_kwh. Update the `current_measured_kwh` / `current_gap_pct_of_mid` fields in the same PR that improves the engine (per RULES.md / AGENTS.md: never raise the baseline to hide a regression).
_source: Extracted from tests/reference_data/zone_balance/case_810_energy_reference.csv (ASHRAE 140-2023 §5.2 HVAC-equipment envelope, validated against Case 900 shared geometry with novel comprehensive HVAC plant — COP 4.0 heat / 6.0 cool, 75% heat recovery, VAV + economizer). Same authoritative source as the strict ±15% annual-energy gate (issue #1333).
description: HVAC-equipment variant: shared Case 900 envelope (high-mass 6m x 8m x 2.7m with 200mm concrete, 12 m² south window, 0.5 ACH), comprehensive HVAC plant (120 kW heating / 150 kW cooling, COP 4.0 / 6.0, 75% heat recovery, VAV + economizer), 21°C heat / 24°C cool, USA_CO_Golden-NREL.724666_TMY3.epw
_tolerance_pct_doc: Strict ±5% gate vs. the EnergyPlus midpoint (Issue #2924 acceptance extended to all surrogate-routed cases per Issue #3584). When the ONNX model is loaded the gate fails on any deviation > 5% of |midpoint|. In fallback mode this becomes a regression ceiling instead (regression_tolerance_kwh below).
_regression_tolerance_kwh_doc: Fallback-mode regression ceiling. The surrogate's current measured kWh may drift by at most this amount between runs (absorbs cross-runner numerical noise). A PR that worsens the gap by more than this against the recorded baseline fails the gate. Tune alongside the engine — do NOT raise to hide a regression.
_current_measured_kwh_doc: Most recent measured surrogate value when the surrogate is in fallback mode (no trained ONNX model shipped). The surrogate's synthetic weather cycle (0–20 °C, see SurrogateThermalLoadAdapter::solve_timesteps in src/sim/thermal_model.rs) cannot reproduce the EnergyPlus outdoor temperature range that drives the published Case 810 cooling demand, so the measured kWh is 0 in the default build. The strict-ORT gate target is energyplus_reference_kwh × (1 ± tolerance_pct/100).
_status_doc: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md: this records the KNOWN gap from the EnergyPlus reference; it must never be loosened to hide a regression. Only lower the gap when the engine genuinely improves and commit the engine fix + baseline update together.
